review_scope: Independent read-only review of generator/export/sampler/trainer; CPU-only tests and artifact report reads. No model, GPU, simulation, training, source-data or source-code modifications.

resolved_findings.finding: Export/training acceptance initially did not require generator_version2 or audited-carry-only feedback, and did not compare noncarry generated actions to original source actions.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current source requires generator_version2, feedback_scope audited_carry_only, noncarry_action_policy exact_source_action and compares every noncarry float32 action byte-for-byte at its pinned source reference index. Legacy/missing contracts and rehashed wrong noncarry actions now have rejection tests.

resolved_findings.finding: Teacher initial state checksum initially only matched its own metadata, not necessarily the approved original source checksum.
resolved_findings.resolution: metadata.initial_sim_state_sha256 and source_initial_sim_state_sha256 must both equal original initial_sim_state_sha256; actual initial array bytes are rehashed. Added self-consistent wrong-initial-state rejection test.

checks.evidence: Generator computes pre=state8(obs) and both RGB arrays from the same obs before env.step(action); fresh post observations are obtained from the resulting current sim state and reused as next pre. Export requires post_state~next state; Arrow state/action/RGB compared against each saved NPZ.

World rotation error is log(R_reference * R_actual^-1), matching left-multiplicative world delta. Only one initial state restoration; no per-frame reference teleports. Actual physics time must equal generated_count*.05 and carry quality gates limit tracking/drop error. Controller hidden cache restoration is approximate and explicitly disclosed; paired rate1 control pilots test this limitation.

Teacher source_kind offline_tracking_teacher, human_actions_only=False, approval_type None; no fake human approval. Base37 public +19 clips/17 sources and10 holdouts validated before teachers; prefix episode files unchanged byte-for-byte; selected ranges, source IDs, heldout IDs and norms inherited unchanged.

LeRobot creates native10-action windows within episode bounds; last9 starts use native terminal padding. RepeatedFrames remaps observation starts after native window construction, never stitches source gaps. Teacher sampling carry group requires all10 reference indices strictly inside protected carry;60/20/15/5 groups partition all real starts and each retained >=once. Alias exact-base equality and pinned SHA validated before training.

Parent numeric course checkpoint and matching norm validated; new experiment cannot overwrite existing checkpoint/launch. Fresh optimizer/data cursor/RNG lineage is explicit. Seed42, horizon10, pi05 discrete_state_inputFalse and LoRA freeze are maintained. Loader monkeypatch restored in finally.

remaining_limits: Successful teacher pilots cover two fixed approved train sources, not broad position generalization or model success.
Quality tracking aggregates are generated and pinned by the reviewed generator; this review did not rerun physics. Export directly recomputes terminal, continuity, provenance and noncarry checks.
P95 tracking gates allow some larger errors; max relative bowl/EEF and minimum height checks bound dropped-grasp cases but do not establish real-world grasp reliability.
Human data remains physically20Hz with nominal10Hz timestamp grid; each generated frame is a real native control action, with no fabricated resampling.
Current pi05 state-input=False limitation remains. Enabling state tokens requires a separate training-and-serving-consistent experiment.
Training start and final real-manifest dry-run/backup are owned by root; reviewer did not launch training.

followup_replay_review.counting: First ten-step gate at c latches completion_step=c. The break condition count>=c+post_release_steps therefore executes exactly the requested number of additional actions; zero default stops on the same gate step as previous behavior.
followup_replay_review.budget: The for loop remains bounded by max_steps. If c+requested exceeds budget, post_release_steps_executed reports the actual remainder and stop_reason is step_limit_after_release; if c+requested exactly equals budget the requested observation window is complete.
followup_replay_review.stability_metric_boundary: post_release_followup_complete verifies requested followup action count only, not that On/open/gap/retreat remain continuously true in those steps. Historical first ten-step gate remains true after subsequent instability. Root confirmed new evaluation will independently analyze followup CSV and bowl drift.
followup_replay_review.legacy_summary_boundary: The old24-run summarize_position_study.py expects first stable gate==stop and legacy stop_reason; root confirmed followup runs use separate analysis, not that legacy summary.
followup_replay_review.minor_cli_observation: Explicit --post-release-steps0 is rejected by positive_int although omitted default0 is accepted. No impact on requested50 or legacy omitted option.
followup_replay_review.root_reported_verification: Root reported RuffPASS and real5-step smoke with requested50/executed0/completeFalse; reviewer did not rerun simulation.
